answer: How do you stop an attacker minting a thousand fakes? Time-locked staking: each identity locks 150 units for 20 epochs, 5% back per honest epoch, so a dune of idle deposits cannot be recycled. Cheating? A fraud proof freezes it, resets the timer, slashes 60%. Why not wait? 1,000 identities tie up 150,000 units for 20 epochs; a 30% fraud rate burns 27,000. The oasis of honest rewards opens only after the lock, and no comet of quick profit arrives.
